mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM parking_spots GROUP BY status
SELECT spot_type, status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM parking_spots GROUP BY spot_type, status ORDER BY spot_type, status

SELECT DATE(r.reserved_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM( TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, r.reserved_at, COALESCE(r.expires_at, NOW())) * s.price_per_hour ), 0) AS revenue FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN parking_spots s ON r.spot_id = s.spot_id WHERE r.reserved_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(r.reserved_at) ORDER BY date
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reservations GROUP BY status
